vocabulary.definition: 一次施放或一次攻击能对多个敌方单位造成伤害
移除目标身上可被弱驱散的效果
使目标的被动技能暂时失效
跟着单位持续影响周围单位；对友军或敌方都算，并记作用对象；固定在地上的区域归场地魔法
技能或物品用一次消耗一点；只决定数值或层数的不算
技能能缩短技能或物品的冷却；A杖或魔晶只降低技能自身冷却的不记，从字段读
使目标短暂离开战场，期间无敌或不可被选取
吸收一定伤害、按比例减少受到的伤害，或把受到的伤害延迟结算（如统帅朗姆酒、虚妄之诺）
自身有概率使敌方攻击落空
提供目标或区域的视野
降低或禁止目标的任何形式生命恢复，含属性回复；提升生命上限的效果不受影响
恢复生命值（治疗、生命恢复），含属性生命恢复（如治疗指环+4.5）
使自身、队友、召唤物或复制体隐身
暂时无法被伤害或无法被指向
攻击或技能恢复自身生命：按造成的伤害、按目标生命或每次攻击固定值（攻击吸血、技能吸血、如噬魂鬼·盛宴、附魂面具）
为自己恢复或从其他单位抽取法力（如莱恩法力吸取），含属性回蓝和回蓝倍率；对友军生效且能给自己回蓝的也算
移动不受单位碰撞阻挡
目标无法移动；带ROOT_DISABLES字段的位移（所有闪烁类）也不能使用
闪烁、冲刺、跳跃、传送等主动改变自身位置
降低移动速度或攻击速度
提高技能造成的伤害
使指向自身或队友的技能失效
把指向技能反弹给施法者
可看见隐身单位

objects.subject: silver_edge
objects.description_en: Active: Shadow Walk Makes you invisible for %windwalk_duration% seconds, or until you attack or cast a spell.  While invisible, you move %windwalk_movement_speed%%% faster and can move through units.    Attacking to end the invisibility will deal %windwalk_bonus_damage% bonus physical damage, disable their passive abilities for %backstab_duration% seconds, and cap their movement speed to %max_movement_speed%.

objects.subject: skadi
objects.description_en: Passive: Cold Attack  Attacks lower enemy movement by %cold_slow_melee%%% if they are melee and %cold_slow_ranged%%% if they are ranged. Attacks also lower enemy attack speed by %cold_attack_slow_melee%%% and Health Restoration by %restoration_reduction%%%. Lasts for %cold_duration% seconds.

objects.subject: solar_crest
objects.description_en: Active: Shine When cast on an ally, grants them %target_armor% armor, %target_attack_speed% attack speed, %target_movement_speed%%% movement speed and a %absorb_amount% physical damage barrier.   Does not grant bonus armor, movement or attack speed if used on self.   Duration: %duration%
notes_en: Shares cooldown with Pavise.

objects.subject: soul_ring
objects.description_en: Active: Sacrifice  Consume %AbilityHealthCost% health to temporarily gain %mana_gain% mana.  Lasts %duration% seconds.  If the mana gained cannot fit in your mana pool, it creates a buffer of mana that will be used before your mana pool.
notes_en: If this mana is not used before the duration ends, the extra mana is lost.

objects.subject: sphere
objects.description_en: Passive: Spellblock Blocks most targeted spells once every %block_cooldown% seconds.   Active: Transfer Spellblock Temporarily removes Spellblock from the item's owner and transfers it to an allied unit for %block_cooldown% seconds.
notes_en: Targeted abilities from neutral items do not trigger Spellblock.

objects.subject: spirit_vessel
objects.description_en: Active: Soul Release  When used against enemies, it reduces health by %enemy_hp_drain%%% of current health per second, and reduces Health Restoration by %restoration_reduction_enemy%%%. Deals %soul_damage_amount% damage per second.   When used on allies, it provides %soul_heal_amount% health regeneration per second.   Lasts %duration% seconds.  Gains charges every time an enemy hero dies within %soul_radius% units or the user dies.
notes_en: Empty vessels gain 2 charges.
Only the closest Spirit Vessel to the dying hero will gain a charge.
If the allied unit is attacked by an enemy hero or Roshan, the effect is lost.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

objects.subject: swift_blink
objects.description_en: Active: Swift Blink  Teleport to a target point up to %blink_range% units away.  After teleportation, you gain %bonus_movement%%% phased movement speed and +%bonus_agi_active% Agility for %duration% seconds.   Swift Blink cannot be used for %blink_damage_cooldown% seconds after taking damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.
notes_en: Self-casting will cause you to teleport in the direction of your team's fountain.

objects.subject: talisman_of_evasion
notes_en: Stacks diminishingly with other sources of Evasion.

objects.subject: tango
objects.description_en: Use: Devour  Consumes a target tree to gain %health_regen% health regeneration for %buff_duration% seconds. Consuming an Ironwood Tree doubles the heal duration.  Comes with %tooltip_charges% charges.  Can be used on an allied hero to give them one Tango.  Tree Range: %abilitycastrange%
notes_en: Heals for double duration when used on a Ironwood Tree or Wards.

objects.subject: tango_single
objects.description_en: Use: Devour  Consumes a target tree to gain %health_regen% health regeneration for %buff_duration% seconds. Consuming an Ironwood Tree doubles the heal duration.  Tree Range: %abilitycastrange%
notes_en: Heals for double duration when used on a Ironwood Tree or Wards.

objects.subject: tpscroll
objects.description_en: Use: Teleport After channeling for %tooltip_channel_time% seconds, teleports you to a target friendly building.   Double-click to teleport to your team's base fountain.
notes_en: If multiple heroes teleport to the same location in succession, the channeling time will be increased for each successive hero.
Teleport can be prevented or canceled by Root abilities.

objects.subject: tranquil_boots
objects.description_en: Passive: Break  Whenever you attack a hero or are attacked by any unit, the bonus %bonus_health_regen% HP regen is lost and the movement speed bonus is reduced to %broken_movement_speed% for %break_time% seconds. Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.

objects.subject: travel_boots
objects.description_en: Upgrade: Town Portal Scroll Upgrades your Town Portal Scroll, allowing it to target units, reduces cooldown and does not consume a charge on usage.  Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.
notes_en: Movement speed bonuses from boots do not stack.

objects.subject: travel_boots_2
objects.description_en: Upgrade: Town Portal Scroll Upgrades your Town Portal Scroll, allowing it to target units and heroes, reduces cooldown, channel time and does not consume a charge on usage.  Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.
notes_en: Movement speed bonuses from boots do not stack.

objects.subject: urn_of_shadows
objects.description_en: Active: Soul Release  Provides %soul_heal_amount% health regeneration when cast on allies, and deals %soul_damage_amount% damage per second when cast on enemies.  Lasts %duration% seconds.  Gains charges every time an enemy hero dies within %soul_radius% units.
notes_en: Empty urns gain 2 charges.
If the allied unit is attacked by an enemy hero or Roshan, the effect is lost.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

objects.subject: vanguard
objects.description_en: Passive: Damage Block  Grants a %block_chance%%% chance to block %block_damage_melee% damage from incoming attacks on melee heroes, and %block_damage_ranged% damage on ranged.
notes_en: Multiple sources of damage block do not stack.

objects.subject: veil_of_discord
objects.description_en: Active: Spell Weakness  Cast a %debuff_radius% radius blast that causes enemy heroes to take %spell_amp%%% increased damage from spells.  Can be cast while channeling.  Duration: %resist_debuff_duration% seconds.
notes_en: Spell Weakness does not stack with Bloodstone's Spell Weakness Aura.

objects.subject: vladmir
objects.description_en: Passive: Vladmir's Aura Grants %lifesteal_aura%%% lifesteal, %damage_aura%%% bonus damage, %mana_regen_aura% mana regeneration, and %armor_aura% armor to nearby allies.  Radius: %aura_radius%
notes_en: Lifesteal on attacks against creeps is reduced to %lifesteal_creeps_tooltip%%%.

objects.subject: voodoo_mask
objects.description_en: Passive: Spell Lifesteal Heals the wearer for a percentage of spell damage dealt to enemies.
notes_en: Does not heal from Pure or Reflected damage.

objects.subject: ward_observer
objects.description_en: Use: Plant Plants an Observer Ward, an invisible watcher that gives ground vision in a %vision_range_tooltip% radius to your team. Lasts %duration_minutes_tooltip% minutes.  Hold Control to give one Observer Ward to an allied hero.

objects.subject: ward_sentry
objects.description_en: Use: Plant  Plants a Sentry Ward, an invisible watcher that grants True Sight, the ability to see invisible enemy units and wards, to any existing allied vision within a %true_sight_range% radius. Lasts %duration_minutes_tooltip% minutes.  Does not grant ground vision. Hold Control to give one Sentry Ward to an allied hero.

objects.subject: wind_waker
objects.description_en: Active: Cyclone  Sweeps a target unit up into a cyclone, making them invulnerable for %cyclone_duration% seconds. Cyclone can be cast on yourself, enemy units or allied units. When cast on yourself, you can move the tornado at a speed of %tornado_speed%.  Enemy units take %tooltip_drop_damage% magical damage upon landing. Dispel Type:  Basic Dispel
notes_en: Cyclone can dispel some buffs and debuffs.
When cast on yourself, the cyclone can be moved anywhere at a speed of 360.
Cyclone duration is unaffected by status resistance.
